body.name: Regret-envelope optimizer confidence set
body.construction: Set \(\underline R_m^{n,\alpha}=\min_{(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\in\operatorname{proj}_{\mathbf r,\mathbf s}\widehat{\mathcal P}_{n,\alpha}}\mathsf R_m(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\), \(\overline R_m^{n,\alpha}=\max_{(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\in\operatorname{proj}_{\mathbf r,\mathbf s}\widehat{\mathcal P}_{n,\alpha}}\mathsf R_m(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\), and \(\widehat{\mathcal M}_{n,\alpha}=\{m\in\mathcal M:\underline R_m^{n,\alpha}\le\min_{j\in\mathcal M}\overline R_j^{n,\alpha}\}\).
